method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual taxpayer, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18. A seat-neutral core (irc-individual.l4, with irc-dates.l4 for the s 6013(b)(2)(A) calendar: computations as functions, duties and permissions as DEONTIC rules) and a seat layer (irc-seat.l4: @export questions with @desc inputs) that imports it. No REFUSE: cases outside the encoding answer `not covered`, asserted. Checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: 26 U.S.C., OLRC USLM XML at release point Public Law 119-121 (current through 2026-10-09), as deposited 2026-10-19 at ../../registers/source-bundle/ (usc26-ch1-schA-ptI.txt, usc26-ch1-schA-ptIV-sptA-C.txt, usc26-ch1-schA-ptVI.txt, usc26-ch1-schB-ptI-III.txt, usc26-ch1-schB-ptV-VII-sel.txt, usc26-ch2.txt, usc26-ch21-schA.txt, usc26-ss6012-6013-7703.txt); 2026 figures from Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (irs-rev-proc-2025-32.txt, ss 4.01, 4.05, 4.06, 4.10, 4.14, 4.23) and the 2026 OASDI contribution and benefit base ($184,500) from 90 FR 49047 (../../../social-security-act/registers/source-bundle/fr-2025-19763-ssa-cola-2026.txt). Taxable year 2026 only.

seat: the individual taxpayer (a US citizen or resident filing for the calendar year 2026, alone or with a spouse)
exports: When does my chance to switch to a joint return end
What does this person count as for me
How much of my Social Security is taxable
How much self-employment tax do I owe
What does my 2026 return come to
regulative_rules: the duty to make a return (s 6012(a), (b), (d); due date from s 6072 as a parameter)
the permission to make a joint return (s 6013(a); a prohibition where a spouse was a nonresident alien, s 6013(a)(1))
the permission to switch to a joint return (s 6013(b)(1), (2)(A): three years from the due date)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run irc-individual.l4 ; l4 run irc-dates.l4 ; l4 run irc-seat.l4 ; l4 run irc-cases.l4 ; l4 run irc-cases-seat.l4
checks.result: 166 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (113 in irc-cases.l4 + 53 in irc-cases-seat.l4), 2026-10-24; two #TRACEs breach on purpose (-- expect: comments) and were read in the diagnostics
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Taxable year 2026, the individual: ss 1(a)-(d), 1(j)(1)-(2) with the 2026 tables as a dated table; s 2(a), (b), (c); s 7703(a), (b); s 6013(a)(1), (b)(1)-(2)(A), (d)(2); s 6012(a)(1)(A)-(D), (b)(1)-(2), (d); ss 61(a), 62(a)(1), 63(a)-(f), 86(a)-(d)(2); s 151 incl. the (d)(5)(C) deduction for seniors; s 152(a)-(d)(2); s 164(f); s 24(a)-(d)(2), (h), (i); s 26(a); s 31(a); s 32(a)-(d), (i), (m); ss 1401(a), (b), 1402(a), (a)(12), (b). Not covered (explicit answers): other years, nonresident aliens, net capital gain and qualified dividends (s 1(h)), the s 1(g) tax (screened), the AMT beyond a screen (s 55), the s 6017 self-employment return. Out: s 152(b)(3)(B), (c)(4) as rules (asked), (d)(3)-(5), (e); s 32(d)(2)(B)(iii)(II); ss 24(g), 32(k); s 911 rules; s 24(j); s 86(e); other credits; s 3101(b)(2); s 6072 (not deposited; a parameter); s 6409 (not deposited).
read_with: ../../../social-security-act/ (Title II benefits taxed under s 86; the contribution and benefit base borrowed by s 1402(b)(1))
state income tax baselines under ../../../<st>/ that start from federal AGI
